title: data: a blank or comma-only `$searchFields` is read as absent, so a search the caller narrowed runs over the default search fields instead of being refused
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcV2ijbfB8Drvs2oik6

QA-source: #27481 · api-backend.query-contract-matrix · observed beside the clauses

Found by an off-clause probe in the 18.3.0 release-candidate QA run (wave anchor #27377, card W3-C1), subject `c4c515ad`, stock showcase boot (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile`, own port and file DB). It is the same class as #26644 / #27008 (an empty list param read as "no restriction"), on a parameter those fixes did not reach.

## Reproduction
Signed in as the seeded admin, on `showcase_account` (14 seeded rows):
1. `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$search=initech&$searchFields=name` → 200, 1 row (`Initech`). Control.
2. `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$search=initech&$searchFields=industry` → 200, 0 rows. The narrowing works.
3. `GET /api/v1/data/showcase_account?$search=initech&$searchFields=` → 200, 1 row (`Initech`).
4. The same with `$searchFields=,` and with the unprefixed `searchFields=` → 200, 1 row.
5. Control for the sibling: `$select=` and `$select=,` on the same door → 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` "Query parameter '$select' names no field".
6. Control for an unknown name: `$searchFields=nope` → 400 `INVALID_FIELD`.

Reproduced on two loads of the same boot.

Expected: a blank or comma-only `$searchFields` answers 400 naming the parameter, exactly as `$select` does since #26644. Actual: it is silently treated as absent, and the search scans the object's default search set, so the request means something other than what the caller wrote.

## Mechanism
`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts` (the folded-slot lowering, around line 1117) splits both `fields` and `searchFields` comma strings into lists and drops blanks, so `""` and `","` become `[]`. The empty-list refusal (`packages/objectql/src/empty-projection-door.ts`, `assertProjectionNamesAField`) covers `fields` only. An empty `searchFields` list is then treated downstream as "no narrowing". The search route has the same blank-to-absent normalisation explicitly (`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, the `searchFields` parse around line 1136–1142: `if (searchFields && searchFields.length === 0) searchFields = undefined`).

## Severity
Low. Access is unchanged: the search still runs under the caller's own RLS and FLS. The answer silently drops the caller's declared narrowing (the `silent-coercion` shape).

Dedupe: searched open and closed issues for "blank $searchFields ignored". The nearest are #24284 (a search term on an object with no searchable field) and #24331, both a different shape and both closed.
